title: P-op1: ProtocolVersion accepted as any u16
description: room-policy-04 §7 lists ProtocolVersion values; RFC 9420 §6 declares ProtocolVersion a closed enum (mls10(1)) with no registry. Readings: (a) strict enum, reject unknown versions; (b) any u16 round-trips. Chosen: (b): a strict enum would make the whole operational-policy component undecodable for any room listing a future version; the codec carries it and enforces nothing (§7 codec only).
